title: Two-Channel Synthesis Subband Filter
text: Reconstruct signal from high-frequency and low-frequency subbands, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Lowpass FIR filter coefficients}, {Highpass FIR filter coefficients}, {Input processing}, {Rate options}, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Coefficients} sets the data type of the coefficients, {Coefficients Minimum} sets the minimum value of filter coefficients, {Coefficients Maximum} sets the maximum value of filter coefficients, {Product output}, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulator, {Output} sets the data type, {Output Minimum}, {Output Maximum} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Input processing Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Rate options Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Data type of the coefficients Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Coefficients Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of filter coefficients [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Coefficients Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of filter coefficients [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
